import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read the provided CSV and aggregate revenue by month and region.
df = pd.read_csv('/mnt/uploads/sales.csv')
monthly_revenue = df.groupby(['month', 'region'], as_index=False)['revenue'].sum()
pivot = monthly_revenue.pivot(index='month', columns='region', values='revenue').fillna(0)

ax = pivot.plot(kind='bar', figsize=(8, 5), width=0.8)
ax.set_title('Revenue by Month and Region')
ax.set_xlabel('Month')
ax.set_ylabel('Revenue')
ax.set_ylim(bottom=0)
ax.legend(title='Region')
plt.xticks(rotation=0)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
